key_insight: Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO) turns policy mirror descent into a trajectory-level objective for terminal-reward autoregressive generation, avoiding intermediate value estimation while preserving the same unique optimum.
engineering_relevance: BPO offers a critic-free reinforcement learning recipe for LLM reasoning tasks, which can simplify training and improve stability in verifiable-reward settings.
method: Reformulate Policy Mirror Descent using Bellman equations over full trajectories.
Eliminate state-value critics at intermediate states.
Approximate the resulting objective with a practical loss whose mismatch-correction weight is a smoothed ratio of complementary token probabilities.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks showing BPO is effective for improving reasoning performance.
watch_item: The practical gain depends on how well the approximate loss and smoothed correction weight match the exact trajectory objective in large-scale training.
